item.title: NOT CONFIRMED: Confusion surrounds new superstore in Watford

item.title: ‘WELL ATTENDED’: Residents enjoy film at French inspired event in Chorleywood
item.description: Residents enjoyed a special screening of the film The Marching Band earlier this month, as part of a joint event run by Chorleywood Film Club and Chorleywood French Twinning Association. item.title: RISING STAR: Former NHS worker awarded for important volunteer work at Northwick Park Hospital
item.description: Families you may be born into or choose, and others – like the NHS – never let you go. item.title: BREAKING NEWS: Snowboarder Charlotte Bankes from Hemel Hempstead secures gold at Winter Olympics
item.description: Charlotte Bankes, from Hemel Hempstead, and Huw Nightingale claimed Team GB’s second gold medal today (Sunday, February 15) in the Olympic Winter Games Milano 2026. item.description: When the first whistle blew in 1886, a legacy began at Kings Langley Football Club (KLFC) that is still bringing people together 140 years later. item.title: ONGOING INVESTIGATION: Police continue appeal for stolen bicycle in Watford
item.description: Police continue to investigate the theft of a bicycle in Watford, which took place last month.
